verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no calendar integration, availability sharing, or scheduling links. It covers only email composition, labels, search, and MCP tools, none of which deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
